name: Research Readout Pastel
tagline: A complete 20-slide research readout with a vertical metadata rail, pastel evidence panels, quotations, editable statistics and clear recommendations.

palette.description: Measured public-preview colors; fine black/white rules and source-specific accents.

typography.style: Implemented fonts selected by preview matching; source font not verified. DM Sans 300/400 and Roboto Mono 300 preserve the source rounded sans-serif main voice and monospaced metadata rail. Font files are embedded offline; the exact files carry SIL OFL 1.1 notices saved alongside the template.

best_for: Everyday qualitative research that connects the objective and methodology to findings, user quotations, prototype evidence, proportional statistics and explicit recommendations.
avoid_for: Dense academic manuscripts, small-print operational tables, and presentations requiring a hosted multiplayer voting service.

source_inspiration.name: Research Readout — Figma Community
source_inspiration.notes: CC BY 4.0 Figma Community slide-deck template. Complete 20 public single-page previews reconstructed in original order; native text/rules/diagrams and independent media. Original fictional example copy and SVG product screens replace generic placeholders. Local navigation replaces the Figma player. Implemented fonts selected by preview matching; source font not verified. DM Sans 300/400 and Roboto Mono 300 preserve the source rounded sans-serif main voice and monospaced metadata rail. Font files are embedded offline; the exact files carry SIL OFL 1.1 notices saved alongside the template. See SOURCE-NOTICES.md for photography and interactive-component boundaries.
